marketing_description: The VELUX FS C01 2004S Fixed Skylight from the FS Series offers a daylight area of 4.43 sq-ft, featuring a laminated, Low-E3 glass type and a pre-finished wood frame in Gray/White. This deck-mount skylight is double glazed and has a rough opening width of 21 in and height of 26-7/8 in. It comes with a White Room-Darkening Solar Powered Shade, providing a range of benefits including energy efficiency, natural light, and UV protection.
